parser_mapping: JS/MJS/CJS/JSX=babel; TS/MTS/CTS/TSX=typescript; Angular HTML=angular; other HTML=html; CSS=css; SCSS=scss; Vue=vue; Svelte=svelte+plugin
physical_lines: Split at LF; count lines whose ECMAScript String.trim() is nonempty; include comments. No whitespace-only lines in final formatted output.
nonwhitespace: count Unicode codepoints for which Python str.isspace() is false; including comments and string contents
snapshot_timing: after generation, before independent acceptance/measurement; generator may already have built
config_loading: Pinned Prettier API with explicit options and fixed Svelte plugin for every file; no application configuration, editorconfig, ignore file or app plugin loading.
selection: Exactly four published Marionette 5.1.0 applications and four retained applications for each of Vanilla, React Router, SvelteKit, Nuxt and Angular.
bytes: Sum of UTF-8 file bytes for the same included source files; report original and formatter-output bytes separately. Not bundle or transfer bytes.
failure_policy: Record every parse/format/encoding/idempotence failure. A build with any included-file failure has null normalized totals and is excluded from no median silently: its framework median is also null.
normalization_passes: Apply identical options repeatedly until output is byte-stable, maximum five formatting transformations; verify stability. Record transformations and formatter calls per file. Seven initial single-pass non-idempotence findings are preserved separately.
